trans-unit.source: The package still ships the legacy keys "%s" in %s. They are mapped onto the section maps at runtime until academic_persons 4.0. Run "academic:persons:settings:migrate" and replace them with the printed maps.
No active package ships the pre-3.0 "validations" or "profileInformationsTypes" keys.
The package removes these entries with "~": %s.
The maps the package copied leave these entries out: %s. The package inherits them, because the settings files are merged per entry. Set an entry to "~" where leaving it out was meant to remove it.
"academic:persons:settings:migrate --delta" prints the smallest file with the same effect.

The fields "%1$s" of the persons settings all name this column. It takes the backend flags of "%2$s", the field applied last, and the flags of the other fields are lost. Give each field a column of its own, or remove the field whose flags the column should not get.
